changelog: Confirmed: v3.12.2's corrected 2026_09_17_0002 applied successfully on live. The challenge is now at 59 trades / 23W / 36L / sum(pnl) -120.08 for the Bitfunded Altcoin challenge, exactly the target end state

Fix: on that run, 0002's idempotent INSERT for CSV row n=1 (ZECUSDT Long) found the ZEC duplicate already present from the original 2026-09-17 run and correctly skipped re-inserting it, so no second duplicate was created — but that also meant only one ZECUSDT row existed in the window 2026_09_17_0003 checks, not the two its pre-flight guard required, so 0003 failed a precondition that was no longer true rather than finding real data trouble

Fix: 2026_09_17_0003 rewritten to detect which of two states is actually live rather than assuming the original incident's exact shape. One ZECUSDT row in the window: asserts it's really id 79 with Bitfunded's own figures and source='import' (confirmed true on live), then does nothing further. Two rows: repairs the keeper (identified by having trade_variables attached, not by a hardcoded id) and deletes the empty duplicate, as before. Zero or more than two: fails loudly rather than guessing. Same +/-5 minute tolerance audit and final state assertions as before either way

No data changes in this release — 2026_09_17_0002 already reached the correct end state on live; this release only makes 0003 a safe no-op against that state instead of a guard failure, so migrate.php stops blocking the queue for future migrations
